kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.siap: A talent scout may leave now.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.desc: One Outer+ disciple at Qi Refining Middle or higher travels for a day and brings back 1-3 youths as candidates (more talented than usual). It earns 40 PK and 10%% of a bar. Once every 5 days. Envoys to other sects are sent from the Diplomacy screen (the Envoy to a Sect mission).
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.perlu_lua: The talent scout must be at least an Outer disciple.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.perlu_men: The talent scout must have reached Qi Refining, Middle.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.tunggu: The next talent scout may leave on day %s.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.berangkat: %s leaves as the sect's talent scout to bring back talented youths.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.pulang: %s is back with %s youth(s) for the Sect Hall!
kultivator.sekte_sambung.bakat.percepat_: The talent scout may leave again at once.
Pays 300 PK from the hall pool so the next talent scout may leave at once.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.aula.saudara.ti: Your group of other players (/sect info): they may build and meditate together (×1.15 cultivation). NPC disciples belong to this hall.
kultivator.sekte_sambung.membangkang: A defiant disciple refuses this duty. Win its heart back first (see Character & Mood).
kultivator.sekte_sambung.hadiah.pk_alasa: A spirit stone gift from the Master
kultivator.sekte_sambung.hadiah.pk: %s keeps the spirit stone as savings of its own: +%s personal PK.
